/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.

  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.

  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
  writes through a `Units` constructor.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Build

/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))

def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)

/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track
    classes := some classes
    kin := { position := some pos
             heading := some heading
             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
             speed := some speed
             extent := some halfExtent
             pathLength := pathLength } }

/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }

def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }
def withRelations (s : Scene) (rs : List MeasuredRelation) : Scene := { s with relations := rs }

/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/
def region (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (boundary : List Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/
def rect (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : Structure :=
  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
/-- A lane with its direction and neighbours. -/
def lane (id : RegionId) (boundary : List Vec) (direction : Vec)
    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
  { id := id
    kind := .lane
    boundary := some boundary
    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
                   entersIntersection := enters } }
def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }

def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=
  { device id .zoneSign governs with zoneKind := some kind, isEnd := some isEnd, conditions := conditions }

/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match u.kin.position with
    | none => []
    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
      | none => none

/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
  { t := t
    subject := subject
    users := users
    structures := structures
    devices := devices
    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)
    env := env
    assumptions := assumptions
    intents := intents }

/-- A trace from a scene generator over instants `t0, t0 + dt, …` (`dt` in seconds). -/
def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
  (List.range n).map fun k =>
    let t : Timestamp := t0 + (Q.mul (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)) (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000))).num /
      (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    f k t

/-- Repeat the first and last scenes for `before`/`after` seconds at spacing `dt`, so that windows
    at the ends of the interesting part are covered rather than truncated. -/
def pad (τ : Trace) (before after dt : Q) : Trace :=
  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
  | some first, some last =>
    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
    pre ++ τ ++ post
  | _, _ => τ

def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ

/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }

end Build

/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
    far enough to decide it. -/
structure Scenario where
  name : String
  rule : String
  trace : Trace
  reading : Reading
  manifest : Manifest
  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
  expected : Verdict
  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
  boundary : String := ""
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Scenario
/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
def pastOps : List String :=
  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
   "heading_since"]

/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
    `unknown` witness only.
    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
    | some r => pure r
    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
    | .ok S => pure S
    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
    match sc.window with
    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
    | none => true
  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"
  match sc.expected with
  | .notApplicable =>
    if tl.present then pure got
    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
  | .unknown _ =>
    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains
      | w => sc.boundary.isEmpty || !truncated w
    if !stray.isEmpty then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
    else pure got
  | _ => pure got
end Scenario

end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
  Exact quantities.

  A statute states feet, inches, miles and miles per hour; another states metres and
  kilometres per hour; a scene states metres and metres per second. None of these convert
  to a common INTEGER unit exactly (a kilometre per hour is 5/18 of a metre per second), so
  quantities are exact rationals over SI base units: metre, second, metre per second,
  metre per second squared, degree. No `Float` anywhere; comparison is by cross-multiplication.

  This is the only file where a unit of law meets a unit of measurement. A rule may write a
  number only as the argument of one of the constructors below (the gate enforces this), so a
  threshold in a rule and the same threshold in a label cannot round differently.
-/
namespace TrafficSpec

/-- An exact rational `num / den` with `den > 0`, kept in lowest terms by `mk'`; `Q.eq` is
    equality by value for the rare unreduced literal. -/
structure Q where
  num : Int
  den : Nat
  den_pos : den > 0 := by decide
  deriving Repr

namespace Q

/-- Structural equality (same numerator and denominator); `Q.eq` is equality by value. -/
instance : DecidableEq Q := fun a b =>
  if h : a.num = b.num ∧ a.den = b.den then
    isTrue (by
      obtain ⟨n₁, d₁, p₁⟩ := a
      obtain ⟨n₂, d₂, p₂⟩ := b
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
      simp only at h1 h2
      subst h1; subst h2; rfl)
  else isFalse (by intro e; subst e; exact h ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)

def ofInt (n : Int) : Q := ⟨n, 1, by decide⟩
def zero : Q := ofInt 0
instance : Inhabited Q := ⟨zero⟩

/-- `a / b` in lowest terms for a positive natural `b`; a zero `b` is treated as one so the value
    stays total. Reducing here keeps chained products and sums from growing without bound. -/
def mk' (a : Int) (b : Nat) : Q :=
  if h : b > 0 then
    let g := Nat.gcd a.natAbs b
    have hg : 0 < g := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ h
    ⟨a / (g : Int), b / g, Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd h (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)) hg⟩
  else ⟨a, 1, by decide⟩

def le (a b : Q) : Bool := a.num * (b.den : Int) ≤ b.num * (a.den : Int)
def lt (a b : Q) : Bool := a.num * (b.den : Int) < b.num * (a.den : Int)
def eq (a b : Q) : Bool := a.num * (b.den : Int) = b.num * (a.den : Int)
def ge (a b : Q) : Bool := le b a
def gt (a b : Q) : Bool := lt b a

def add (a b : Q) : Q := mk' (a.num * b.den + b.num * a.den) (a.den * b.den)
def sub (a b : Q) : Q := mk' (a.num * b.den - b.num * a.den) (a.den * b.den)
def mul (a b : Q) : Q := mk' (a.num * b.num) (a.den * b.den)
def neg (a : Q) : Q := ⟨-a.num, a.den, a.den_pos⟩
def abs (a : Q) : Q := ⟨if a.num < 0 then -a.num else a.num, a.den, a.den_pos⟩
/-- `a / b`; division by zero yields zero (the callers guard it and report `unknown`). -/
def div (a b : Q) : Q :=
  if b.num = 0 then zero
  else if b.num > 0 then mk' (a.num * b.den) (a.den * b.num.toNat)
  else mk' (-(a.num * b.den)) (a.den * (-b.num).toNat)
def half (a : Q) : Q := mk' a.num (a.den * 2)
def min (a b : Q) : Q := if le a b then a else b
def max (a b : Q) : Q := if le a b then b else a
def isZero (a : Q) : Bool := a.num = 0
def isNonneg (a : Q) : Bool := a.num ≥ 0

instance : Add Q := ⟨add⟩
instance : Sub Q := ⟨sub⟩
instance : Mul Q := ⟨mul⟩
instance : Neg Q := ⟨neg⟩

end Q

/-- Integer square root (floor), by Newton's iteration from `n` with fuel; exact for all `n`. -/
def isqrtAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, _, x => x
  | fuel + 1, n, x =>
    if x = 0 then 0
    else
      let y := (x + n / x) / 2
      if y ≥ x then x else isqrtAux fuel n y

def isqrt (n : Nat) : Nat := if n < 2 then n else isqrtAux 256 n n

theorem isqrt_zero : isqrt 0 = 0 := rfl
theorem isqrt_one : isqrt 1 = 1 := rfl

namespace Units

-- Lengths (metres).
def metres (n : Int) : Q := Q.ofInt n
def centimetres (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' n 100
def millimetres (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' n 1000
/-- Micrometres: the integer unit adapters use for measured lengths. -/
def micrometres (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' n 1000000
def kilometres (n : Int) : Q := Q.ofInt (n * 1000)
def inches (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' (n * 254) 10000          -- 25.4 mm exactly
def feet (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' (n * 3048) 10000           -- 304.8 mm exactly
def yards (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' (n * 9144) 10000
def miles (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' (n * 1609344) 1000        -- 1609.344 m exactly

-- Durations (seconds).
def seconds (n : Int) : Q := Q.ofInt n
def milliseconds (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' n 1000
def minutes (n : Int) : Q := Q.ofInt (n * 60)
def hours (n : Int) : Q := Q.ofInt (n * 3600)

-- Speeds (metres per second).
def metresPerSecond (n : Int) : Q := Q.ofInt n
/-- Micrometres per second: the integer unit adapters use for measured speeds. -/
def micrometresPerSecond (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' n 1000000
def kmh (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' (n * 1000) 3600              -- exactly 5/18 m/s per km/h
def mph (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' (n * 44704) 100000           -- 0.44704 m/s exactly

-- Curvatures (per metre).
def perMetre (n : Int) : Q := Q.ofInt n

-- Accelerations (metres per second squared).
def metresPerSecondSq (n : Int) : Q := Q.ofInt n
def micrometresPerSecondSq (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' n 1000000

-- Angles (degrees) and rates (degrees per second).
def degrees (n : Int) : Q := Q.ofInt n
def millidegrees (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' n 1000

-- Dimensionless.
def ratio (a : Int) (b : Nat) : Q := Q.mk' a b
def percent (n : Int) : Q := Q.mk' n 100

end Units
end TrafficSpec

def vX : Arg := .lit "x"
def vY : Arg := .lit "y"

/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle -/
def clsSubject : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle"] []

/-- The subject's speed (kin.speed). -/
def speedOf : Term := .measure "kin_speed" [vSubject]

/-- The subject's full width (kin.extent). -/
def widthOf : Term := .measure "kin_extent" [vSubject, .lit "width"]

/-- The surface gap between the subject and road user `v` (rel.surface_gap). -/
def gapTo (v : String) : Term := .measure "rel_surface_gap" [vSubject, .var v]

/-- Signed lateral offset of region `r` from the subject (prim.region_lateral_offset, left positive). -/
def offsetOf (r : String) : Term := .quantity "prim_region_lateral_offset" [vSubject, .var r] []

/-- u2: the motor vehicle moves (speed above the halt tolerance). -/
def moving : Formula := .cmp speedOf .gt pHaltSpeedTolerance

/-- u3: its speed plus the impeding margin is below the value of a maximum speed limit sign
    governing a travel region it occupies. -/
def belowPosted : Formula :=
  .existsDevice (.lit "speed_limit_sign") "d"
    (.and (.atom "dev_speed_limit_sign_kind" [.var "d", .lit "maximum"] [])
      (.and (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "tr"
               (.and (.atom "rel_occupies" [vSubject, .var "tr"] [])
                     (.atom "dev_governs" [.var "d", .var "tr"] [])))
            (.cmp (.add speedOf pImpedingSpeedMargin) .lt
                  (.measure "dev_speed_limit_sign_value" [.var "d"]))))

/-- u4: a traffic road user behind the subject in the same lane, the surface gap within reach. -/

  .existsUser "t"
    (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "t", .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic"] [])
      (.and (.atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var "t"] [])
            (.cmp (gapTo "t") .le pRearSignalReach)))

    u4 (trigger): traffic proceeding immediately behind the driver or operator,
    u5 (subject): the driver or operator shall:
    u6 (condition): If the highway has one lane for traveling in each direction
    u7 (standard): and the width of the paved portion permits,
    u8 (obligation): drive to the extreme right side of the highway
    u9 (reference): and, if applicable, comply with the provisions of NRS 484B.630.

  Elements (span → atoms, derived):
    u1: atoms ['ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle'], derived []
    u2: atoms ['kin.speed', 'ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle'], derived []
    u4: atoms ['ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic', 'rel.ahead_behind_in_lane', 'rel.surface_gap'], derived []
    u5: atoms ['ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle'], derived []

import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_627_1a

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vSubject : Arg := .var "subject"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pFreePassageWidth : Term := .param "p.free_passage_width"
def pHaltSpeedTolerance : Term := .param "p.halt_speed_tolerance"
def pImpedingSpeedMargin : Term := .param "p.impeding_speed_margin"
def pLaneOpposedDirectionCos : Term := .param "p.lane_opposed_direction_cos"
def pLeftLaneMoveOverTime : Term := .param "p.left_lane_move_over_time"
def pPulloverEdgeGap : Term := .param "p.pullover_edge_gap"
def pRearSignalReach : Term := .param "p.rear_signal_reach"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- The text's literal "one" (u6): one lane in each direction. -/
def oneLane : Term := .lit (Units.ratio 1 1) .count

def vX : Arg := .lit "x"
def vY : Arg := .lit "y"

/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle -/
def clsSubject : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle"] []

/-- The subject's speed (kin.speed). -/
def speedOf : Term := .measure "kin_speed" [vSubject]

/-- The subject's full width (kin.extent). -/
def widthOf : Term := .measure "kin_extent" [vSubject, .lit "width"]

/-- The surface gap between the subject and road user `v` (rel.surface_gap). -/
def gapTo (v : String) : Term := .measure "rel_surface_gap" [vSubject, .var v]

/-- Signed lateral offset of region `r` from the subject (prim.region_lateral_offset, left positive). -/
def offsetOf (r : String) : Term := .quantity "prim_region_lateral_offset" [vSubject, .var r] []

/-- u2: the motor vehicle moves (speed above the halt tolerance). -/
def moving : Formula := .cmp speedOf .gt pHaltSpeedTolerance

/-- u3: its speed plus the impeding margin is below the value of a maximum speed limit sign
    governing a travel region it occupies. -/
def belowPosted : Formula :=
  .existsDevice (.lit "speed_limit_sign") "d"
    (.and (.atom "dev_speed_limit_sign_kind" [.var "d", .lit "maximum"] [])
      (.and (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "tr"
               (.and (.atom "rel_occupies" [vSubject, .var "tr"] [])
                     (.atom "dev_governs" [.var "d", .var "tr"] [])))
            (.cmp (.add speedOf pImpedingSpeedMargin) .lt
                  (.measure "dev_speed_limit_sign_value" [.var "d"]))))

/-- u4: a traffic road user behind the subject in the same lane, the surface gap within reach. -/
def trafficBehind : Formula :=
  .existsUser "t"
    (.and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "t", .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic"] [])
      (.and (.atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [vSubject, .var "t"] [])
            (.cmp (gapTo "t") .le pRearSignalReach)))

/-- u3: no road user ahead of the subject in the same lane within reach (it is not held back). -/
def noneAhead : Formula :=
  .forallUser "o"
    (.not (.and (.atom "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" [.var "o", vSubject] [])
                (.cmp (gapTo "o") .le pRearSignalReach)))

/-- u3 with u2 and u4, sustained over the move-over window behind. -/
def impeding : Formula :=
  .holdsFor .time pLeftLaneMoveOverTime "subject"
    (.and moving (.and belowPosted (.and trafficBehind noneAhead)))

/-- The dot product of the designated directions of lanes `a` and `b` (st.lane_direction). -/
def dirDot (a b : String) : Term :=
  .add (.mul (.measure "st_lane_direction" [.var a, vX]) (.measure "st_lane_direction" [.var b, vX]))
       (.mul (.measure "st_lane_direction" [.var a, vY]) (.measure "st_lane_direction" [.var b, vY]))

/-- Lane `o` lies on way `w` and its designated direction is opposed to lane `l`'s. -/
def opposedOn (l o w : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "st_on_way" [.var o, .var w] [])
       (.cmp (dirDot l o) .lt (.neg pLaneOpposedDirectionCos))

def countOf (r : String) : Term := .measure "st_lane_adjacency_count" [.var r]

/-- u6: the subject occupies a lane lying on a highway whose count in its direction is one; some
    lane of that highway is opposed in direction, and every opposed lane's count is one. -/
def oneLaneEachWay : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "lane") "l"
    (.and (.atom "rel_occupies" [vSubject, .var "l"] [])
      (.existsRegion (.lit "highway") "w"
        (.and (.atom "st_on_way" [.var "l", .var "w"] [])
          (.and (.cmp (countOf "l") .eq oneLane)
            (.and (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "ol" (opposedOn "l" "ol" "w"))
                  (.forallRegion (.lit "lane") "ol2"
                    (.implies (opposedOn "l" "ol2" "w") (.cmp (countOf "ol2") .eq oneLane))))))))

/-- The right-hand road edge `e` of the highway `w`: a road edge lying on it, to the subject's right. -/
def rightEdgeOf (e w : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "st_on_way" [.var e, .var w] [])
       (.cmp (offsetOf e) .lt zeroMetres)

/-- u7: on the highway the subject occupies, the centre line's and the right road edge's lateral
    offsets, in magnitude, sum to at least the subject's width plus the free passage width. -/
def widthPermits : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "highway") "w"
    (.and (.atom "rel_occupies" [vSubject, .var "w"] [])
      (.existsRegion (.lit "centre_line") "c"
        (.and (.atom "st_on_way" [.var "c", .var "w"] [])
          (.existsRegion (.lit "road_edge") "e"
            (.and (rightEdgeOf "e" "w")
                  (.cmp (.add (.abs (offsetOf "c")) (.abs (offsetOf "e"))) .ge
                        (.add widthOf pFreePassageWidth)))))))

/-- Applicability: u1/u2 (moving motor vehicle), u3 (so slow as to impede, over the move-over
    window), u4 (traffic immediately behind), u6 (one lane each direction), u7 (width permits). -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  .and impeding (.and oneLaneEachWay widthPermits)

/-- Obligation (u8): the right side of the subject is within the pull-over gap of the right road
    edge of the highway it occupies: |offset| − width/2 ≤ gap, written without a halving literal as
    |offset| + |offset| ≤ width + gap + gap. -/
def obligation : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "highway") "w"
    (.and (.atom "rel_occupies" [vSubject, .var "w"] [])
      (.existsRegion (.lit "road_edge") "e"
        (.and (rightEdgeOf "e" "w")
              (.cmp (.add (.abs (offsetOf "e")) (.abs (offsetOf "e"))) .le
                    (.add widthOf (.add pPulloverEdgeGap pPulloverEdgeGap))))))

def rule : Rule :=
  { id := "NRS_484B_627_1a"
    laws := ["NRS-484B-627-1a"]
    binders :=
      [ { name := "subject", cls := clsSubject } ]
    applicability := applicability
    obligation := obligation
    assumptions := []
    intentions := []
    operationalizations :=
      [ { standard := "so slow as to impede the forward movement of traffic"
          concepts := ["dev.governs", "dev.speed_limit_sign", "kin.speed", "rel.ahead_behind_in_lane", "rel.occupies", "rel.surface_gap", "st.travel_region"]
          params := ["p.impeding_speed_margin", "p.rear_signal_reach", "p.left_lane_move_over_time", "p.halt_speed_tolerance"]
          convention := "Slow-moving-vehicle practice: the subject impedes the traffic behind it where, at every observation of the window of p.left_lane_move_over_time behind (the time a driver needs to check, signal and move over once a faster vehicle closes), it moves (speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) at a speed more than p.impeding_speed_margin below the value of a maximum speed limit sign governing a travel region it occupies, a traffic road user is behind it in the same lane within p.rear_signal_reach, and no road user is ahead of it in the same lane within p.rear_signal_reach, so the subject is not itself held back."
          surrogate := false }
      , { standard := "the width of the paved portion permits"
          concepts := ["kin.extent", "prim.region_lateral_offset", "st.centre_line", "st.road_edge"]
          params := ["p.free_passage_width"]
          convention := "Lateral clearance of a passing vehicle: the paved half of the roadway, from the centre line to the right road edge (the sum of the magnitudes of their lateral offsets from the subject), is at least the subject's width plus p.free_passage_width, so that with the subject at the right edge a following vehicle has room to pass beside it."
          surrogate := false } ]
    residues := ["NRS 484B.630 has no node in the library, so its turnout duty cannot be composed; the rule does not judge compliance with it."]  -- the node's, verbatim; not yours to change
    narrowings := []  -- one { span := "<span id>", why := "<why>", kind := "reading" } per reading you chose on a carried span (kind no_atom / no_operator where the words cannot be stated), explained in the header; the record's own narrowings are not restated
    surrogate := false }

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_627_1a.

  Geometry (the witness's own figures, none in the rule). A two-way highway (region 1) runs east
  along x, from y = −2 to y = 2·half + 2 where `half` is the paved half width (5.5 m; 3.2 m in
  branch_1). Lane 10 (eastbound, count 1) spans y ∈ [0, half]; lane 11 (westbound, count 1) spans
  y ∈ [half, 2·half]. The centre line (20) is the strip y ∈ [half, half + 0.1], the right road edge
  (21) the strip y ∈ [−0.1, 0], the left road edge (22) the strip y ∈ [2·half, 2·half + 0.1]; all lie
  on highway 1. A maximum speed limit sign (30) of 25 m/s governs lane 10.

  The subject (track 1, a motor vehicle, 4.5 m × 1.8 m) heads east at 15 m/s (24 m/s in branch_2)
  from x = −200, at lateral position y = 2.7 (right side 1.8 m from the edge; y = 1.3 in permit,
  right side 0.4 m). A following car (track 2) runs at the same speed 10 m (body gap) behind it in
  lane 10; in branch_3 a leading car (track 3) runs 10 m ahead of it. Scenes every second over
  0 … 15 s; the witnesses speak about 12 … 15 s, so the 10 s move-over window is covered.

  Reading values used: margin 4.5 m/s (15 + 4.5 < 25; 24 + 4.5 > 25), reach 30 m (gap 10 m),
  free passage 3.0 m (width 1.8 + 3.0 = 4.8 ≤ 5.5, > 3.2), pull-over gap 1.0 m (right side 1.8 m
  breaks it, 0.4 m keeps it), opposed cosine 0.9 (east·west = −1).
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_627_1a
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_627_1a

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

/-- Half extents of a car: 4.5 m long, 1.8 m wide, 1.5 m high. -/
def carHalf : Q × Q × Q := (cm 225, cm 90, cm 75)

/-- The carriageway with a paved half of `half` metres (as centimetres). -/
def structures (halfCm : Int) : List Structure :=
  let h := cm halfCm
  let h2 := cm (2 * halfCm)
  let x0 := m (-1000); let x1 := m 1000
  let onWay (s : Structure) : Structure := { s with ways := some [1] }
  [ Build.rect 1 .highway x0 (m (-2)) x1 (Q.add h2 (m 2))
  , onWay (Build.lane 10 [(x0, Q.zero), (x1, Q.zero), (x1, h), (x0, h)] Build.east
      (ordinal := some 1) (count := some 1))
  , onWay (Build.lane 11 [(x0, h), (x1, h), (x1, h2), (x0, h2)] Build.west
      (ordinal := some 1) (count := some 1))
  , onWay (Build.rect 20 .centreLine x0 h x1 (Q.add h (cm 10)))
  , onWay (Build.rect 21 .roadEdge x0 (cm (-10)) x1 Q.zero)
  , onWay (Build.rect 22 .roadEdge x0 h2 x1 (Q.add h2 (cm 10))) ]

def devices : List Device := [Build.speedLimit 30 [10] (Units.metresPerSecond 25) .maximum]

/-- A scene at step `k`: subject at lateral `yCm`, speed `v`; follower and leader optional. -/
def sceneAt (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) (halfCm yCm : Int) (v : Int)
    (follower leader : Bool) : Scene :=
  let x : Q := Q.add (m (-200)) (Units.metres (v * Int.ofNat k))
  let y := cm yCm
  let speed := Units.metresPerSecond v
  let subj := Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] (x, y) Build.east speed carHalf
  let fol := Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (Q.sub x (cm 1450), y) Build.east speed carHalf
  let lead := Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (Q.add x (cm 1450), y) Build.east speed carHalf
  let users := [subj] ++ (if follower then [fol] else []) ++ (if leader then [lead] else [])
  Build.scene t (some 1) users (structures halfCm) devices

def mkTrace (halfCm yCm v : Int) (follower : Bool := true) (leader : Bool := false) : Trace :=
  Build.trace 16 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t => sceneAt k t halfCm yCm v follower leader

/-- `forbid` (violated): A car on a two-lane two-way highway (one lane in its direction, centre line present) under a 25 m/s maximum sign has moved at 15 m/s for longer than the move-over time with a car 10 m behind it in its lane and no one ahead; the paved half is 5.5 m wide, enough for its width plus the passage width; its right side stays 1.8 m from the right road edge. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := mkTrace 550 270 15

/-- `permit` (compliant): The same scene, but the car's right side runs 0.4 m from the right road edge. -/
def permitTrace : Trace := mkTrace 550 130 15

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The same slow car on the same highway with no road user behind it. -/
def idleTrace : Trace := mkTrace 550 270 15 (follower := false)

/-- `blind` (unknown): As in forbid, but the source does not supply the gap between the car and the vehicle behind it, so whether traffic is immediately behind is unobserved. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := mkTrace 550 270 15

/-- `branch_1` (not_applicable): As in forbid, but the paved half of the roadway is 3.2 m: it is narrower than the car's width plus the passage width, so the width does not permit. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace := mkTrace 320 270 15

/-- `branch_2` (not_applicable): As in forbid, but the car travels at 24 m/s under the 25 m/s maximum: it is not slow. -/

3	  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
4	-/
5	/-
6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Manifest
7	  What a source can observe: a capability per atom id, complete over ATOMS.md (`subject` is an atom
8	  observed for the subject track alone, as an instrumented vehicle reports its own controls); a mask
9	  that blanks every field of an absent atom, and of a subject-only atom on every other road user,
10	  before evaluation; and `support`, the first and most honest number
11	  a source gets — which rules it can be judged against at all, computed from the rules' syntax
12	  before any frame is read.
13	
14	  The same rules run on a simulator, on an annotated dataset and on perception over video; the
15	  only thing that differs is what each can see, and that difference is a declared input here.
16	  For the perception stage the manifest is the interface the other way round: the list of atoms
17	  its programs must deliver, with the error class each is allowed.
18	-/
19	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
20	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
21	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Ontology.Ids
22	
23	namespace TrafficSpec
24	
25	inductive Capability
26	  | exact
27	  | estimate (errorClass : String)
28	  | absent
29	  | subject
30	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
31	
32	structure Manifest where
33	  source : String
34	  entries : List (String × Capability)     -- atom id in ATOMS.md form ↦ capability
35	  /-- The longest tracker break the source's re-identification links may bridge (seconds). -/
36	  reidGap : Q := Q.zero
37	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
38	
39	namespace Manifest
40	/-- An atom the manifest does not list is absent: silence is not a capability. -/
41	def capability (m : Manifest) (id : String) : Capability :=
42	  ((m.entries.find? (·.1 == id)).map (·.2)).getD .absent
43	def observes (m : Manifest) (id : String) : Bool := m.capability id != .absent
44	/-- Complete: every atom id of ATOMS.md has an entry, and no entry names anything else. -/
45	def complete (m : Manifest) : Bool :=
46	  atomIds.all (fun id => (m.entries.find? (·.1 == id)).isSome) &&
47	  m.entries.all (fun e => atomIds.contains e.1)
48	def absentIds (m : Manifest) : List String := atomIds.filter fun id => !m.observes id
49	/-- The atoms observed for the subject track only. -/
50	def subjectIds (m : Manifest) : List String := atomIds.filter fun id => m.capability id == .subject
51	/-- A manifest that observes everything exactly (the simulator's, and the tests'). -/
52	def full (source : String) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
53	  { source := source, entries := atomIds.map fun id => (id, .exact), reidGap := gap }
54	end Manifest
55	
56	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
57	-- From Lean names back to atom ids
58	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
59	/-- The atom id a Lean name reads: the longest id whose `defName` is a prefix of the name
60	    (`dev_traffic_signal_shows` ↦ `dev.traffic_signal`), with the relation aliases spelled out. -/
61	def atomIdOf (name : String) : Option String :=
62	  let n := match name with
63	    | "rel_ahead_in_lane" | "rel_behind_in_lane" => "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane"
64	    | other => other
65	  let cands := atomIds.filter fun id =>
66	    let d := Semantics.defName id
67	    n == d || n.startsWith (d ++ "_")
68	  cands.foldl (fun acc id => match acc with
69	    | none => some id
70	    | some a => if id.length > a.length then some id else some a) none
71	
72	/-- The atom ids a read of `id` depends on: itself, and for a read of a region kind or of a relation
73	    that reads kind membership, the kinds whose masks its verdict follows (a kind's ancestors; a
74	    lane relation's lane kind; an entrance's line kinds, stop line and crosswalk). No source
75	    declares an abstract kind: a read of one depends on the kinds refining it directly, and no read
76	    depends on an abstract ancestor. -/
77	def kindDependencies (id : String) : List String :=
78	  let kinds (ks : List StructureKind) := (ks.filter (!·.isAbstract)).map fun k => s!"st.{k}"
79	  let ofKind (k : StructureKind) :=
80	    if k.isAbstract then kinds (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k))
81	    else kinds (k :: k.ancestors)
82	  match id with
83	  | "rel.ahead_behind_in_lane" => id :: ofKind .lane
84	  | "st.entrance_of" => id :: ofKind .stopLine ++ ofKind .crosswalk
85	  | _ =>
86	    if id.startsWith "st." then
87	      match StructureKind.ofString ((id.drop 3).toString) with
88	      | some k => ofKind k
89	      | none => [id]
90	    else [id]
91	
92	/-- The atom ids a formula list reads, through atoms and primitives (a concept call is expanded first). -/
93	def formulaAtomIds (fs : List Formula) : List String :=
94	  ((fs.flatMap Formula.atoms).flatMap fun n =>
95	    if n.startsWith "prim_" then (Primitives.reads n).filterMap atomIdOf
96	    else (atomIdOf n).toList).flatMap kindDependencies |>.eraseDups
97	
98	/-- The atom ids a rule reads, through its atoms, its primitives and, transitively, the
99	    rules it composes. -/
100	def Rule.atomIds (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) : List String :=
101	  let rec go (fuel : Nat) (seen : List String) (r : Rule) : List String :=
102	    match fuel with
103	    | 0 => formulaAtomIds r.formulas
104	    | fuel + 1 =>
105	      formulaAtomIds r.formulas ++ (r.composes.flatMap fun id =>
106	        if seen.contains id then [] else
107	        match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
108	        | some r' => go fuel (id :: seen) r'
109	        | none => [])
110	  (go rules.length [r.id] r).eraseDups
111	
112	inductive Support
113	  | supported
114	  | partially (absent : List String)      -- some atoms unobserved: verdicts may be unknown
115	  | unsupported (absent : List String)    -- the obligation reads nothing the source observes
116	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
117	
118	def Support.tag : Support → String
119	  | .supported => "supported"
120	  | .partially _ => "partial"
121	  | .unsupported _ => "unsupported"
122	def Support.absent : Support → List String
123	  | .supported => []
124	  | .partially a | .unsupported a => a
125	
126	/-- Support from syntax alone, closed over the rules a rule composes. Unsupported when every atom
127	    the obligation reads is absent (the rule could never decide), or a binder's class can never be
128	    established, or a composed rule is itself unsupported. -/
129	def support (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (m : Manifest) : Support :=
130	  -- the clock is every source's: a window over time reads it, and no manifest declares it absent
131	  let absentOf (fs : List Formula) : List String × Nat :=
132	    let ids := (formulaAtomIds fs).filter (· != "kin.time")
133	    (ids.filter fun id => !m.observes id, ids.length)
134	  let (oblAbsent, oblTotal) := absentOf [r.obligation]
135	  let clsDead := r.binders.any fun b =>
136	    let (a, n) := absentOf [b.cls]
137	    n > 0 && a.length == n
138	  let composedDead := (r.composes.filterMap fun id => rules.find? (·.id == id)).any fun r' =>
139	    let (a, n) := absentOf [r'.obligation]
140	    n > 0 && a.length == n
141	  let allAbsent := (Rule.atomIds rules r).filter fun id => !m.observes id
142	  if allAbsent.isEmpty then .supported
143	  else if clsDead || composedDead || (oblTotal > 0 && oblAbsent.length == oblTotal) then .unsupported allAbsent
144	  else .partially allAbsent
145

147	-- Masking: a scene as the source would have produced it
148	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
149	namespace Mask
150	def user (id : String) (u : RoadUser) : RoadUser :=
151	  match id with
152	  | "ru.subject" => u
153	  | "ru.occupant_count" => { u with occupants := none }
154	  | "ru.rider_posture" => { u with posture := {} }
155	  | "kin.position" => { u with kin := { u.kin with position := none } }
156	  | "kin.heading" => { u with kin := { u.kin with heading := none } }
157	  | "kin.velocity" => { u with kin := { u.kin with velocity := none } }
158	  | "kin.speed" => { u with kin := { u.kin with speed := none } }
159	  | "kin.accel_longitudinal" => { u with kin := { u.kin with accelLongitudinal := none } }
160	  | "kin.yaw_rate" => { u with kin := { u.kin with yawRate := none } }
161	  | "kin.extent" => { u with kin := { u.kin with extent := none } }
162	  | "kin.steer_angle" => { u with kin := { u.kin with steerAngle := none } }
163	  | "kin.path_length" => { u with kin := { u.kin with pathLength := none } }
164	  | "kin.engine_running" => { u with kin := { u.kin with engineRunning := none } }
165	  | "kin.parking_brake" => { u with kin := { u.kin with parkingBrake := none } }
166	  | "kin.gear" => { u with kin := { u.kin with gear := none } }
167	  | "kin.throttle" => { u with kin := { u.kin with throttle := none } }
168	  | "kin.service_brake" => { u with kin := { u.kin with serviceBrake := none } }
169	  | "sig.turn_indicator" => { u with sig := { u.sig with turnIndicator := none } }
170	  | "sig.brake_lamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with brakeLamp := none } }
171	  | "sig.hazard" => { u with sig := { u.sig with hazard := none } }
172	  | "sig.headlamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with headlamp := none } }
173	  | "sig.position_lamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with positionLamp := none } }
174	  | "sig.warning_lamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with warningLamps := none } }
175	  | "sig.siren" => { u with sig := { u.sig with siren := none } }
176	  | "sig.horn" => { u with sig := { u.sig with horn := none } }
177	  | "sig.hand_signal" => { u with sig := { u.sig with handSignal := none } }
178	  | "ru.aggregate" => { u with classes := none }   -- the source classifies nothing: every member unknown
179	  | "sig.door_open" => { u with sig := { u.sig with doorsOpen := none } }
180	  | "sig.compression_brake" => { u with sig := { u.sig with compressionBrake := none } }
181	  | "st.sight_along_way" => { u with sightAlongWay := none }
182	  | _ =>
183	    -- a class atom: the source cannot tell this class, so no user is known to have or lack it,
184	    -- nor the attribute the class carries
185	    match RoadUserClass.ofString ((id.drop 3).toString) with
186	    | some k =>
187	      let u := { u with classes := u.classes.map (·.filter (· != k)), unobservedClasses := k :: u.unobservedClasses }
188	      match k with
189	      | .emergencyVehicle => { u with emergencyKind := none }
190	      | .officialVehicle => { u with officialKind := none }
191	      | .electricBicycle => { u with eBikeClass := none }
192	      | _ => u
193	    | none => u
194	
195	def structure' (id : String) (st : Structure) : Option Structure :=
196	  match id with
197	  | "st.lane_direction" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with direction := none } }
198	  | "st.lane_adjacency" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l =>
199	      { l with leftNeighbour := none, rightNeighbour := none, ordinalFromLeft := none, countInDirection := none } }
200	  | "st.lane_connectivity" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with leadsTo := none } }
201	  | "st.lane_enters" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with entersIntersection := none } }
202	  | "st.lane_marking" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with markingLeft := none, markingRight := none } }
203	  | "st.lane_width" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with width := none } }
204	  | "st.curvature" => some { st with curvature := none }
205	  | "st.grade" => some { st with grade := none }
206	  | "st.sight_distance" => some { st with sightDistance := none }
207	  | "st.on_way" => some { st with ways := none }
208	  | "st.entrance_of" => some { st with entranceOf := [], entranceObserved := false }
209	  | "st.region_geometry" => some { st with position := none, boundary := none }
210	  | _ =>
211	    -- a kind atom: the source cannot tell this kind; a kind that refines another is unknown only on
212	    -- the regions labelled with one of its ancestors (`Structure.isOfKind`); an abstract kind is
213	    -- never declared: what a source cannot tell of it is what it cannot tell of the kinds refining it
214	    match StructureKind.ofString ((id.drop 3).toString) with
215	    | some k => if k.isAbstract then some st else some { st with unobservedKinds := k :: st.unobservedKinds }
216	    | none => some st
217	
218	def device (id : String) (d : Device) : Option Device :=
219	  match id with
220	  | "dev.governs" => some { d with governs := [], governsObserved := false }
221	  | "dev.position" => some { d with position := none }
222	  | "dev.inoperative" => some { d with inoperative := none }
223	  | _ =>
224	    -- a kind atom: the source cannot tell this kind, so no device is known to be or not be one
225	    match DeviceKind.ofString ((id.drop 4).toString) with
226	    | some k => some { d with unobservedKinds := k :: d.unobservedKinds }
227	    | none => some d
228	
229	def env (id : String) (e : Env) : Env :=
230	  match id with
231	  | "env.darkness" => { e with darkness := none }
232	  | "env.precipitation" => { e with precipitation := none }
233	  | "env.wet_road" => { e with wetRoad := none }
234	  | "env.ice_or_snow" => { e with iceOrSnow := none }
235	  | "env.visibility" => { e with visibility := none }
236	  | "env.civil_time" => { e with civilTime := none }
237	  | _ => e
238	
239	def relation (id : String) (m : MeasuredRelation) : MeasuredRelation :=
240	  match id with
241	  | "rel.centre_distance" => { m with centreDistance := none }
242	  | "rel.surface_gap" => { m with surfaceGap := none }
243	  | "rel.ahead_behind_in_lane" => { m with aAheadOfB := none }
244	  | "rel.longitudinal_overlap" => { m with longitudinalOverlap := none }
245	  | "rel.oncoming" => { m with oncoming := none }
246	  | "rel.same_direction" => { m with sameDirection := none }
247	  | "rel.bearing" => { m with bearing := none }
248	  | "rel.contact" => { m with contact := none }
249	  | "rel.visible" => { m with visible := none }
250	  | _ => m
251	
252	/-- Blank one atom in a scene. The computed relations are blanked through the kinematics they
253	    would be computed from only when the source lacks those too; a measured value is dropped. -/
254	def scene (id : String) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
255	  match id with
256	  | "ru.subject" => { s with subject := none }
257	  | "rel.occupies" => { s with occupancyObserved := [], occupies := [] }
258	  | "kin.time" => s
259	  | _ =>
260	    { s with users := s.users.map (user id)
261	             structures := s.structures.filterMap (structure' id)
262	             devices := s.devices.filterMap (device id)
263	             env := env id s.env
264	             relations := s.relations.map (relation id) }
265	
266	/-- Blank one atom on every road user but the subject, and in every measured relation not taken
267	    from the subject: what a source that instruments the subject's vehicle alone can say. -/
268	def sceneExceptSubject (id : String) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
269	  { s with users := s.users.map fun u => if s.subject == some u.track then u else user id u
270	           relations := s.relations.map fun m => if s.subject == some m.a then m else relation id m }
271	end Mask
272	
273	/-- The scene as the source would have produced it: every absent atom blanked, every subject-only
274	    atom blanked on everyone but the subject. -/
275	def mask (m : Manifest) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
276	  let s := m.absentIds.foldl (fun acc id => Mask.scene id acc) s
277	  m.subjectIds.foldl (fun acc id => Mask.sceneExceptSubject id acc) s
278	def maskTrace (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := τ.map (mask m)
279	
280	end TrafficSpec

(follower leader measuredGap : Bool) : Scene :=
  let x : Q := Q.add (m (-200)) (Units.metres (v * Int.ofNat k))
  let y := cm yCm
  let speed := Units.metresPerSecond v
  let subj := Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] (x, y) Build.east speed carHalf
  let fol0 := Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (Q.sub x (cm 1450), y) Build.east speed carHalf
  -- with a measured gap, the follower's body size is not observed: Core cannot compute the gap
  let fol := if measuredGap then Build.withKin fol0 (fun kn => { kn with extent := none }) else fol0
  let lead := Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (Q.add x (cm 1450), y) Build.east speed carHalf
  let users := [subj] ++ (if follower then [fol] else []) ++ (if leader then [lead] else [])
  let s := Build.scene t (some 1) users (structures halfCm) devices
  if measuredGap then
    Build.withRelations s [Build.relation 1 2 (fun r => { r with surfaceGap := some (m 10, Q.zero) })]
  else s

def mkTrace (halfCm yCm v : Int) (follower : Bool := true) (leader : Bool := false)
    (measuredGap : Bool := false) : Trace :=
  Build.trace 16 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t => sceneAt k t halfCm yCm v follower leader measuredGap

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_627_1a.

  Geometry (the witness's own figures, none in the rule). A two-way highway (region 1) runs east
  along x, from y = −2 to y = 2·half + 2 where `half` is the paved half width (5.5 m; 3.2 m in
  branch_1). Lane 10 (eastbound, count 1) spans y ∈ [0, half]; lane 11 (westbound, count 1) spans
  y ∈ [half, 2·half]. The centre line (20) is the strip y ∈ [half, half + 0.1], the right road edge
  (21) the strip y ∈ [−0.1, 0], the left road edge (22) the strip y ∈ [2·half, 2·half + 0.1]; all lie
  on highway 1. A maximum speed limit sign (30) of 25 m/s governs lane 10.

  The subject (track 1, a motor vehicle, 4.5 m × 1.8 m) heads east at 15 m/s (24 m/s in branch_2)
  from x = −200, at lateral position y = 2.7 (right side 1.8 m from the edge; y = 1.3 in permit,
  right side 0.4 m). A following car (track 2) runs at the same speed 10 m (body gap) behind it in
  lane 10; in branch_3 a leading car (track 3) runs 10 m ahead of it. Scenes every second over

import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_627_1a

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

/-- Half extents of a car: 4.5 m long, 1.8 m wide, 1.5 m high. -/

/-- The carriageway with a paved half of `half` metres (as centimetres). -/
def structures (halfCm : Int) : List Structure :=
  let h := cm halfCm
  let h2 := cm (2 * halfCm)
  let x0 := m (-1000); let x1 := m 1000
  let onWay (s : Structure) : Structure := { s with ways := some [1] }
  [ Build.rect 1 .highway x0 (m (-2)) x1 (Q.add h2 (m 2))
  , onWay (Build.lane 10 [(x0, Q.zero), (x1, Q.zero), (x1, h), (x0, h)] Build.east
      (ordinal := some 1) (count := some 1))
  , onWay (Build.lane 11 [(x0, h), (x1, h), (x1, h2), (x0, h2)] Build.west
      (ordinal := some 1) (count := some 1))
  , onWay (Build.rect 20 .centreLine x0 h x1 (Q.add h (cm 10)))
  , onWay (Build.rect 21 .roadEdge x0 (cm (-10)) x1 Q.zero)
  , onWay (Build.rect 22 .roadEdge x0 h2 x1 (Q.add h2 (cm 10))) ]

def devices : List Device := [Build.speedLimit 30 [10] (Units.metresPerSecond 25) .maximum]

def permitTrace : Trace := mkTrace 550 130 15

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The same slow car on the same highway with no road user behind it. -/
def idleTrace : Trace := mkTrace 550 270 15 (follower := false)

/-- `blind` (unknown): As in forbid, but the source does not supply the gap between the car and the vehicle behind it, so whether traffic is immediately behind is unobserved. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := mkTrace 550 270 15 (measuredGap := true)

/-- `branch_1` (not_applicable): As in forbid, but the paved half of the roadway is 3.2 m: it is narrower than the car's width plus the passage width, so the width does not permit. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace := mkTrace 320 270 15

/-- `branch_2` (not_applicable): As in forbid, but the car travels at 24 m/s under the 25 m/s maximum: it is not slow. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace := mkTrace 550 270 24

/-- `branch_3` (not_applicable): As in forbid, but a car runs 10 m ahead of it in its lane: it is itself held back, not impeding. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace := mkTrace 550 270 15 (leader := true)

/-- The instants the witnesses speak about: the move-over window behind each is covered. -/
def judged : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := some (12000, 15000)

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_627_1a"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("subject", 1)]
    expected := expected
    window := judged
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) ["rel.surface_gap"]
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .notApplicable ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_627_1a

# NRS_484B_627_1a — task result

**Final verdict: OK** (8 witnesses, 20 names, composes nothing). 4 of 6 gate runs used.

## Gate runs
1. **WITNESS_FAIL**: `blind` returned violated. Masking `rel.surface_gap` only drops a *measured* gap. Core still computed the gap from both bodies' kinematics.
   - Change: in `blind`, the follower's extent is left unobserved, and the source supplies a measured 10 m gap, which the manifest then masks.
2. **WITNESS_FAIL**: the adapter refuses a track that is in `occupancyObserved` but has no footprint.
   - Change: in `blind`, only the subject's occupancy is observed. The source supplies the in-lane order (1 ahead of 2, 2 not ahead of 1) as measured relations. Core cannot compute that order without the follower's occupancy, so supplying it is legitimate.
3. **VACUOUS**: leaves 15 and 16 had no witness that moved them. They are `st_on_way ol2 w` and the direction-opposition comparison inside "every opposed lane counts one".
   - Change: added `branch_4` (not_applicable). The opposite direction has two westbound lanes, each with count two.
4. **OK**.

## How the rule is written
- **Class (u1/u5):** `ru_aggregate subject "DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle"`.
- **Applicability:**
  - **u2, u3, u4 (impeding):** a `holdsFor .time p.left_lane_move_over_time` window on the subject. At every observation in it:
    - the subject's speed is above `p.halt_speed_tolerance`;
    - there is a `speed_limit_sign` device of kind `maximum` that governs a `travel_region` the subject occupies, and speed + `p.impeding_speed_margin` is below its value;
    - some `traffic` road user `t` is behind the subject in its lane (`rel_ahead_behind_in_lane subject t`) with `rel_surface_gap ≤ p.rear_signal_reach`;
    - no road user `o` is ahead of the subject in its lane (`rel_ahead_behind_in_lane o subject`) within that reach.
  - **u6 (one lane each way):**
    - the subject occupies a lane `l` that lies on a highway `w`, and `l`'s count in its direction is the literal one (`Units.ratio 1 1`, unit `.count`);
    - some lane on `w` has a direction-dot with `l` below −`p.lane_opposed_direction_cos`;
    - every such opposed lane on `w` also has count one.
  - **u7 (width permits):** on a highway `w` the subject occupies, take a centre line on `w` and a right road edge on `w`. The magnitudes of their two lateral offsets sum to at least the subject's width + `p.free_passage_width`. A "right road edge" is a road edge on `w` whose `prim_region_lateral_offset` is negative.
- **Obligation (u8):** on a highway the subject occupies, the right road edge is selected the same way as in u7. It must satisfy `|off| + |off| ≤ width + gap + gap`, which is `|off| − width/2 ≤ p.pullover_edge_gap` rewritten so that no halving literal is needed.
- **u9:** stays the node's residue.

## Choices the node left open
- The right road edge is picked by the sign of its lateral offset: negative means right, which is the record's own "negative to the right" convention.
- The right edge is quantified existentially in both formulas, as the right-hand edge of the highway the subject occupies.
- The centre line in u7 is the one lying on that same occupied highway (`st_on_way`), because "the paved portion" belongs to that highway.

None of these narrows a duty span beyond its words, so no narrowings were added.

## Witnesses
- **Planned:** forbid, permit, idle, blind, branch_1 and branch_2, each as narrated.
- **Added:**
  - `branch_3`: a car 10 m ahead in the subject's lane, so the subject is held back (not_applicable).
  - `branch_4`: two lanes in the opposite direction (not_applicable).
- **Trace:** 16 one-second scenes; the verdicts are judged over 12–15 s so the 10 s window is fully covered.

## Note for later sessions
Masking `rel.surface_gap` blanks only a measured gap. A blind witness on it needs a source that cannot compute the gap, here because the follower's extent is unobserved. Because occupancy must then also be unobserved for that track, the in-lane order has to be supplied as a measurement.
